title: Functional Ore Stairs+
description: Adds functional ore themed stairs with unique features like redstone power, enchanting support, furnace fuel, and piglin interactions.
body:
# Functional Ore Stairs+

**Functional Ore Stairs+** adds ore-themed stair blocks to Minecraft, but with a twist: several stairs are not only decorative, they also have useful material-based mechanics.

Build with iron, gold, diamond, emerald, redstone, lapis, and coal stairs while keeping a vanilla-friendly survival balance.

## Features

* **Iron Stairs** – strong metal stairs for industrial builds, bases, bunkers, and modern structures.
* **Gold Stairs** – Piglins react when you break them nearby, just like vanilla gold blocks.
* **Diamond Stairs** – valuable decorative stairs for luxury builds, treasure rooms, and rich survival bases.
* **Emerald Stairs** – special rare stairs obtained through Journeyman Mason villager trades instead of crafting.
* **Redstone Stairs** – emit redstone power, connect with redstone dust, and allow redstone dust to be placed on top.
* **Lapis Lazuli Stairs** – support enchanting setups; two lapis stairs count as one bookshelf effect and create enchanting particles.
* **Coal Stairs** – can be used as furnace fuel, smelting up to 4 items per stair.

## Supported Versions

* Minecraft **1.20.1** – Forge
* Minecraft **1.21.1** – NeoForge

Functional Ore Stairs+ is made for players who want more ore block variants, more creative building options, and functional stair blocks that still feel natural in vanilla Minecraft.

You can also find Functional Ore Stairs+ on CurseForge.
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/functionalorestairs
